name: spider-team
description: /spider-team: the session implements the task, calls a planner, researcher or reviewer when they help, splits off parallel workers only when that pays, and shows the run in a progress band and an agents pane

max_workers.title: Parallel workers
max_workers.description: The most spider-worker agents /spider-team runs at once.

planner_effort.title: Planner effort
planner_effort.description: The effort /spider-team asks for when it calls the planner (Opus 5.5). subagent-effort, when active, replaces it.

worker_effort.title: Worker effort
worker_effort.description: The effort /spider-team asks for when it calls the worker (Sonnet 5.5). subagent-effort, when active, replaces it.

researcher_effort.title: Researcher effort
researcher_effort.description: The effort /spider-team asks for when it calls the researcher (Haiku 5.5). subagent-effort, when active, replaces it.

reviewer_effort.title: Reviewer effort
reviewer_effort.description: The effort /spider-team asks for when it calls the reviewer (Opus 5.5). subagent-effort, when active, replaces it.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows the Claude Code language setting, then the system locale; pt-BR or en fix it.

autoOpen.title: Open the agents pane
autoOpen.description: team: when a spider-team run starts; any: when a subagent starts with none running; off: only with /spider-agents.

showCost.title: Show estimated cost
showCost.description: Estimated from token counts and a dated price table; never a bill.

showTokens.title: Show tokens
showTokens.description: Input, output and cache tokens per agent and in total.

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: How full each agent's context window is, when the window is known.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: A spinner beside running agents; off keeps a fixed mark.

historyLimit.title: Agents kept
historyLimit.description: How many agents the pane remembers (20 to 1000); the oldest finished ones go first.
